context.transcript:
Ms. Benedetti, welcome to Humboldt Broadcasting Company.
I'm Charles Jones, Senior Producer of the Morning News Program.
Thanks.
I'm excited about being on the show.
It'll be great exposure for my new book.
I think it will be.
We typically average two and a half million viewers per episode.
And let me introduce you to our production assistant, Alex Tanaka.
We'll be talking with you to prepare for your interview on the show tomorrow.
It's nice to meet you, Ms. Benedetti.
I'm a big fan of your writing.
Thanks.
Before getting started, may I have a cup of coffee?
Certainly.
Just a moment.
context.transcript_translation:
Benedetti女士，欢迎来到Humboldt广播公司。
我是Charles Jones，晨间新闻节目的高级制作人。
谢谢。
我对能登上这个节目感到兴奋。
这对我的新书来说将是很好的曝光机会。
我想会的。
我们通常每集平均有两百五十万的观众。
让我介绍一下我们的制作助理Alex Tanaka给您认识。
我们将与您进行一次谈话，为您明天在节目上的采访做准备。
很高兴见到您，Benedetti女士。
我是您写作的忠实粉丝。
谢谢。
在我们开始之前，我可以喝杯咖啡吗？
当然可以。
请稍等。
